# Landingsite.ai

> > AI-powered website and landing page builder that creates professional websites, logos, and SEO-optimized pages in minutes without coding.

Landingsite.ai is a no-code platform founded by Todd Hooper and Andrew Homeyer that leverages artificial intelligence to generate complete websites and landing pages with custom copy, design, and logos. The platform serves individual creators, agencies, and industry-specific businesses with flexible pricing plans and enterprise-grade features like white-label options and unlimited client websites.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered website builder
- Landing page generator
- SEO optimization
- No-code platform
- Logo design
- Mobile-responsive design
- Conversion optimization
- SSL & hosting
- White-label solutions
- Industry-specific templates
- Free trial
- Agency plans
- Core Web Vitals
- GDPR compliance
- Domain management

## Core Products

- [AI Website Builder](https://www.landingsite.ai/ai-website-builder): Core product page for AI website builder with custom copy, design, logo, and SEO.
- [AI Landing Page Builder](https://www.landingsite.ai/landing-page-builder): Landing page builder tool with AI copywriting and conversion optimization features.
- [SEO Landing Pages](https://www.landingsite.ai/seo-landing-pages): SEO-optimized landing pages with Core Web Vitals, mobile-first design, and fast loading.
- [Free AI Website Builder](https://www.landingsite.ai/free-ai-website-builder): Free tier offering complete AI-built website preview with no credit card required.

## Pricing & Plans

- [Pricing](https://www.landingsite.ai/pricing): Pricing page with Free, Basic, and Pro plans including hosting, SSL, and domain features.
- [Agency Plan](https://www.landingsite.ai/agencies): Agency plan offering unlimited websites, white-label previews, and AI edit credits.

## Industry Solutions

- [Moving Company Website Builder](https://www.landingsite.ai/moving-company-website-builder): Industry-specific builder for moving companies with local SEO and service showcases.
- [Marketing Agency Website Builder](https://www.landingsite.ai/marketing-agency-website-builder): Marketing agency-focused builder with portfolio showcase and lead generation features.
- [Law Firm Website Builder](https://www.landingsite.ai/law-firm-website-builder): Legal industry builder with attorney bios, practice areas, and GDPR-compliant forms.
